prompt: Name an official Girl Scout cookie variety.

answers.name: Thin Mints
answers.fact: The best seller by a wide margin — roughly a quarter of every box sold.

answers.name: Samoas
answers.fact: One cookie, two names: Caramel deLites from the other licensed baker.

answers.name: Tagalongs
answers.fact: Sold as Peanut Butter Patties by the other baker.

answers.name: Trefoils
answers.fact: Shaped like the Girl Scout emblem, and closest to the original 1917 recipe.

answers.name: Do-si-dos
answers.fact: Oatmeal sandwich cookies, sold elsewhere as Peanut Butter Sandwich.

answers.name: Lemon-Ups
answers.fact: Each cookie is stamped with a different motivational phrase.

answers.name: Adventurefuls
answers.fact: Introduced in 2022: a brownie cookie with caramel and sea salt.

answers.name: Toffee-tastic
answers.fact: Gluten free, and made by only one of the two bakers.

answers.name: Lemonades
answers.fact: The other baker's lemon cookie, iced on one side.

answers.name: Caramel Chocolate Chip
answers.fact: Gluten free, chewy, and not sold in every council.

answers.name: Exploremores
answers.fact: New for 2026, a rocky-road-inspired sandwich cookie.
